description: Inti.js behavior specifications. Each scenario declares in 'verifiedBy' which test checks it, and those that carry 'testLogic' are run as they are. packages/core/tests/specs.test.ts fails if a scenario has no verification, if it points to a file that does not exist or if its testLogic does not hold.

scenarios.scenario: Successful mapping of data from Kitsuden CMS to IntiPage
given: the response of GET /pages/:idOrSlug carries the title 'Inicio' and one block row of type 'hero'
scenarios.when: the 'Kitsuden Adapter' processes the raw payload
then: the result must implement the 'IntiPage' interface
the 'IntiPage.title' field must be exactly 'Inicio'
the 'IntiPage.blocks' array must contain an 'IntiBlock' of type 'hero' that keeps the row's uuid

scenarios.scenario: An invalid payload is rejected instead of inventing a page
given: the external data source returns a payload without the required fields
scenarios.when: the corresponding Adapter tries to process the payload
then: the adapter must throw an error explaining that the payload is not a page
no 'IntiPage' with invented values must be returned
the caller decides whether to serve a 404 or an error page, because only it knows the context

scenarios.scenario: Blocks are sorted by sortOrder even if the API returns them out of order
given: Kitsuden returns the block rows in an order different from their sortOrder
scenarios.when: the adapter processes the page and then resolves an index to write
then: the blocks must end up sorted by sortOrder
index N of the page and index N of the write must point to the same row
editing block N must never write to another block

scenarios.scenario: Rendering a mapped block
given: the 'HeroBanner' block has its component in src/blocks/HeroBanner.astro, registered with registerBlocks
then: it must render the component with the CMS fields as props
it must wrap it with the attributes the editor uses to know where to write

scenarios.scenario: Graceful degradation for unregistered blocks (Fallback)
given: the CMS sends a block of a type with no registered component
then: the system must not throw a 500 error
in development it must show a box saying which file is missing
in production it must show nothing

scenarios.scenario: Hidden blocks or blocks outside their date window are not published
given: the CMS marks a block as hidden, or gives it a date window that does not include today
scenarios.when: BlockRenderer processes the page in production
then: the block must not reach the HTML
in the editor it must stay visible, marked, so it can be reactivated
hiding a block must not renumber the others

scenarios.scenario: A write with no one to check it is rejected
given: the site is in production and no plugin declares beforeWrite or resolveActor
scenarios.when: someone sends a request to a write action
then: the write must be rejected before touching the CMS
the error must explain how to protect it
opening it on purpose must require INTI_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS_WRITES=1 and leave a warning

scenarios.scenario: The editor, search and the realtime channel require an editor session
scenarios.when: a request without an editor session asks for the page, /api/inti/search or /api/inti/sync
then: the page must not include the editor or the block data
search and the channel must respond 401
a plugin registered from any copy of the module must open the session to the editor

scenarios.scenario: A visitor receives no Inti JavaScript
given: an anonymous visitor opens a published page
then: the page must not load any module script
images must still arrive with srcset

scenarios.scenario: The documented setup works on Astro 5, 6 and 7
given: a clean project with the full setup from AGENTS.md, installed from the packed packages
scenarios.when: it is built, started in development and started in production
then: the build must finish without errors
astro dev must serve the page and all its modules without errors
production must satisfy the security and rendering scenarios

scenarios.scenario: Clean project using the native Inti.js engine
given: the project does not use Tailwind: neither a config file nor a dependency
then: it must enable UnoCSS with Tailwind-compatible classes

scenarios.scenario: With Tailwind 3 or 4 in the project, UnoCSS steps aside
given: the project uses Tailwind: a tailwind.config.* (v3) or the tailwindcss / @tailwindcss/vite dependency (v4, no file)
then: it must detect Tailwind and say why it detected it
it must not enable UnoCSS, to avoid class collisions
it must say how to include Inti's components in the class scan, depending on the version

scenarios.scenario: Saving a page with images and relations
Changing a page without the visitor seeing it
Undoing a text edit
The model cannot invent data or markup
A proposal writes nothing until accepted
Composition during the visit
Choosing a zone's version without AI
The adapted response does not go to a shared cache
Observing requires consent
An agent composes over MCP
Editing and publishing against a real instance
A model cannot invent a Kitsuden media item
What is written, Keystatic reads
A site works on workerd
One editing room per document
